steps.en: Staff open a page listing the excluded IDs
steps.id: Staff membuka halaman daftar ID yang dikecualikan

steps.en: Staff add a new ID with remarks
steps.id: Staff menambah ID baru beserta remarks
steps.why_en: Adding an ID that already exists is not rejected; the old remarks are silently overwritten.
steps.why_id: Menambah ID yang sudah ada tidak ditolak, remarks lama tertimpa diam-diam.

steps.why_en: Only the remarks can be changed; the ID cannot be replaced.
steps.why_id: Hanya catatan yang bisa diubah; ID tidak bisa diganti.

steps.en: Staff remove an ID from the list
steps.why_en: Delete exists only in the backend; the page has no delete button.
steps.why_id: Hapus hanya ada di backend; halaman tidak punya tombol hapus.

steps.en: List changes apply on the next run
steps.id: Perubahan daftar berlaku di proses berikutnya
